description: Connection 1 opens as FORCE (its feed) and is later closed with feed KLINE; connection 2 opens as KLINE and is reopened with feed FORCE. One CONN_FEED_CONFLICT per conflicting event, where = the CONN line. A last CONN event with feed OTHER is BAD_EVENT and, being invalid, is excluded from the conflict rule (no CONN_FEED_CONFLICT for it).
title: a later CONN event names another feed
